description:
Video Effects SDK adds real-time video effects to iOS apps: background blur and replacement, beautification, smart zoom, color correction, color grading by a reference image, LUT color filters, low light adjustment, sharpening, noise suppression and portrait lighting.
See the integration sample: https://github.com/EffectsSDK/ios-swift-integration-sample
